Package services

Class MastodonPostMapperTest

java.lang.Object
services.MastodonPostMapperTest
public class MastodonPostMapperTest extends Object
Verifies timeline mapping with synthetic JSON and no network calls.

AI assistance: test-design and implementation support for the Phase 3 request for exact mapping assertions and malformed-data partitions.

Author:
Nabeel Ali
